definitions.explanation: The right or power of a community, organization, or region to govern itself independently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧{自治|じち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: Local self-government is the basis of democracy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{自治|じち}⟦{会|かい}→会：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{企画|きかく}した→企画：04879_kikaku⟧。
examples.english: The student council organized an event.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自治|じち}⟦{権|けん}→権：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。

notes:
USAGE: Used in political, organizational, and administrative contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧{自治|じち} (local self-government)
- {自治|じち}⟦{体|たい}→体：noentry⟧ (municipality, local authority)
- {自治|じち}⟦{会|かい}→会：noentry⟧ (self-governing body, student council)
- {自治|じち}⟦{権|けん}→権：noentry⟧ (autonomy, right of self-government)
- ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧{自治|じち} (resident self-governance)

IN JAPAN: {自治|じち}⟦{体|たい}→体：noentry⟧ refers to prefectures, cities, towns, and villages that have local governing powers.
